name: c11_follow_me_mirror
purpose: Two Indeedee-F: with Follow Me on both sides each side's single-target moves go to the other side's Indeedee-F, and both volatiles end in one residual (a Speed tie); a Wave Crash boosted by Helping Hand and aimed at Kingambit goes to the foe's Follow Me user; Follow Me never takes its own side's moves; Milotic's Ice Beam aimed at a foe that fainted this turn is retargeted, then redirected; Kingambit's Iron Head aimed at its own ally goes to the foe's Follow Me user; after that user faints, Kingambit's Iron Head reaches its target.
